general.description: A mini-game server, under construction, savvy?

section1.title: Ahoy! Welcome to SakuraLands!
content: Play with yer mates from every corner o' the globe, ahoy!
Join epic mini-games, adventures, an' more, heave ho!

section2.title: Many Tongues!
content: All pirates from every port o' call be welcome!
Our crew speaks many tongues, so ye'll always find shipmates to plunder with!
section2.warning: * Some words be machine-translated, an' may not be accurate, shiver me timbers!

section3.title: Many Mini-games!
content: Enjoy a bounty o' mini-games: parkour, skywars, bedwars, escape maze, an' more, avast!
There be always somethin' new to try, arrr!

section4.title: Safety!
content: We care for fair play an' yer safety!
Our friendly staff team be lookin' out to make yer experience safe an' fun, aye!
